stageNote: Routed planning for F-BUG002-008 only. The test owner may replace only the two whole-worktree rollback oracles and their mutation plumbing with the closed eleven-path governed inventory and eight-path mutation boundary. Existing SCN-012-003 titles, behavior assertions, fixture authority, product bytes, Feature 017, Feature 019, Feature 028, company publication, and human acceptance remain unchanged. No implementation, post-repair pass, delivery, or certification is claimed.
designPrerequisite: Record the F-BUG002-008 eleven-path governed inventory, eight-path mutation boundary, and governed-change, unauthorized-write, and unrelated-file controls in design.md before test implementation.

scenarios.title: Reconciled Git history cannot invalidate the legacy rehearsal

gherkin.given: a committed fixture contains the seven exact pre-Scope-03 authority files and a manifest records each SHA-256 and semantic role
gherkin.when: both SCN-012-003 rollback tests reconstruct their legacy sandbox
gherkin.then: each baseline file comes only from the committed fixture, no Git ref is read at runtime, and both tests reach their existing behavioral assertions

obligations.requiredProof: The fixture resolver returns the exact manifest-backed bytes for every closed authority path without reading Git history.
An unknown, missing, changed, or modern-contaminated fixture path produces a named fail-loud assertion instead of a fallback.
The committed manifest has one exact entry for each of the seven allowed paths with byte length, SHA-256, role, and source provenance.

linkedTests.testTitle: SCN-012-003 isolated rollback restores legacy providers and exact current Scope 03 bytes
SCN-012-003 exact TP-03-01 through TP-03-05 commands replay RED then GREEN in isolated rollback baseline

testMechanism.negativeControl: Changing one fixture byte, removing one manifest path, or adding a modern decorator marker in an isolated copy must produce the corresponding path-specific guard failure.

scenarios.title: Baseline drift fails without weakening current behavior

gherkin.given: legacy fixture pages contain no Scope 03 decorator marker and current canary pages contain the shared decorator wiring
gherkin.when: the rollback rehearsal restores current Scope 03 bytes and the production route is exercised
gherkin.then: the legacy negative assertion, restored-current positive assertion, provider parity, and visible contextual disclosure all remain active

obligations.requiredProof: The current production route still exposes the contextual disclosure by pointer, keyboard, touch, and adjacent table.
Provider and page parity remains equal across rollback and exact restore, and the current externally visible surface still consumes the shared context engine.
A fixture that contains modern decorators or does not match its manifest fails before any legacy assertion can pass vacuously.

linkedTests.testTitle: Regression: SCN-012-003 Power chart context is equivalent by pointer keyboard touch and table

testMechanism.negativeControl: Removing the shared decorator wiring from one current canary page must fail the restored-current functional assertion and the production-route disclosure assertion.

scenarios.title: Rollback isolation ignores unrelated concurrent files

gherkin.given: the rollback oracle governs exactly eleven Scope 03 paths and rollback writes and deletes are limited to the eight production paths
gherkin.when: a governed path changes, an unauthorized rollback write is attempted, and an unrelated sandbox file changes
gherkin.then: the governed mutation is named and rejected, the unauthorized write fails before mutation, and the unrelated file does not affect the governed comparison

obligations.requiredProof: Both exact rollback tests compare hashes for only the eleven governed paths, and the comparison names the first changed governed path.
A changed governed byte and an unauthorized rollback path fail loud, while a changed unrelated sandbox file leaves the governed comparison equal.
The governed inventory is the canonical eleven-path list and the mutation inventory is its canonical eight-path production subset with no discovery expansion.

linkedTests.testTitle: SCN-012-003 isolated rollback restores legacy providers and exact current Scope 03 bytes
SCN-012-003 exact TP-03-01 through TP-03-05 commands replay RED then GREEN in isolated rollback baseline
Regression: F-BUG002-008 scoped rollback oracle catches governed mutation and ignores unrelated concurrent files

testMechanism.negativeControl: Flip one byte in sandbox rlcontext.js and require a named failure; attempt a rollback write to concurrency-control/unrelated-report.md and require pre-write rejection; then change that unrelated file directly and require the eleven governed hashes to remain equal.
